daily.title: Who Must File Form PAS-6 in India? Share Capital Reconciliation and Filing Deadline
daily.summary: India's Ministry of Corporate Affairs Form PAS-6 requires applicable unlisted public and non-small private companies to reconcile issued capital with demat and physical shares. Companies required to hold their securities in dematerialised form must ensure that their issued share capital reconciles accurately with the securities held in demat and physical form. India’s Union Ministry of Corporate Affair’s (MCA) Form PAS-6 supports this through a half-yearly reconciliation of share capital with the records of depositories and the registrar and transfer agent (RTA).
